name: Voltage divider 1 kΩ / 2 kΩ (5 V to 3.3 V signal)
description: Level-shifts a 5 V output (HC-SR04 ECHO) for a 3.3 V GPIO: 5 V in gives 3.33 V out.
notes: 5 V x 2k/(1k+2k) = 3.33 V: above the ESP32 VIH minimum (0.75 x 3.3 = 2.475 V) and below its 3.6 V maximum (ESP32 datasheet). Echo is 5 V (Cytron HC-SR04 manual). Mass and size are for two through-hole resistors (estimate).
